measures.name: m_order_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_paid_order_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_valid_order_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_cancelled_order_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_refund_order_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_partial_refund_order_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 AND refund_cents < paid_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_full_refund_order_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > 0 AND refund_cents = paid_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_payment_cents
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_refund_cents
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN refund_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_net_sales_cents
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_gross_cents
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_discount_cents
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents - paid_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_buyer_count_distinct
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id END

measures.name: m_refund_buyer_count_distinct
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id END

measures.name: m_selling_store_count_distinct
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN store_id END

measures.name: m_valid_order_items
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_first_buyer_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN valid_seq = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_first_order_sales_cents
measures.expr: CASE WHEN valid_seq = 1 THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_first_order_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN valid_seq = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_repeat_order_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN valid_seq >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: m_new_member_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.expr: buyer_count

measures.expr: repeat_buyer_count

measures.expr: buyer_count

metrics.name: order_count
metrics.label: 创建订单数
metrics.description: 按下单日期统计全部订单，每个订单号一次，包含取消单。

metrics.name: paid_order_count
metrics.label: 支付订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 paid 的订单数，包括后来全部退款的订单。

metrics.name: valid_order_count
metrics.label: 有效订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 paid 且实付金额减退款金额大于零的订单数；取消和全退不计。

metrics.name: cancelled_order_count
metrics.label: 取消订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 cancelled 的订单数。

metrics.name: refund_order_count
metrics.label: 退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且退款金额大于零的订单数，包括部分退款与全部退款。

metrics.name: partial_refund_order_count
metrics.label: 部分退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且退款大于零、小于实付金额的订单数。

metrics.name: full_refund_order_count
metrics.label: 全额退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且实付大于零、退款等于实付的订单数。

metrics.name: payment_cents
metrics.label: 实付金额
metrics.description: paid 订单实付金额合计，尚未扣退款；单位分。

metrics.name: refund_cents
metrics.label: 退款金额
metrics.description: paid 订单退款金额合计，按原订单下单日期归属，不是现金退款发生日；单位分。

metrics.name: net_sales_cents
metrics.label: 净销售额
metrics.description: paid 订单实付减退款后合计；取消单不计；按原订单下单日期归属；单位分。

metrics.name: gross_cents
metrics.label: 支付订单原价金额
metrics.description: paid 订单折扣前原价金额合计；单位分。

metrics.name: discount_cents
metrics.label: 优惠金额
metrics.description: paid 订单原价减实付的金额合计；退款不冲减原优惠金额；单位分。

metrics.name: buyer_count
metrics.label: 购买会员数
metrics.description: 统计窗口及筛选条件内有有效订单的不同 CRM 会员账户数，不做跨系统自然人去重。

metrics.name: refund_buyer_count
metrics.label: 退款会员数
metrics.description: 统计窗口内发生退款的 paid 订单关联的不同 CRM 会员账户数。

metrics.name: selling_store_count
metrics.label: 成交门店数
metrics.description: 窗口内至少有一笔有效订单的不同订单归属门店数。

metrics.name: valid_order_items
metrics.label: 有效订单商品件数
metrics.description: 有效订单中的原始购买件数合计；退款金额不能推算退货件数，此项不是净商品销量。

metrics.name: avg_order_value
metrics.label: 有效订单均额
metrics.description: 净销售额除以有效订单数，单位分／单；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: avg_buyer_value
metrics.label: 购买会员人均消费
metrics.description: 净销售额除以购买会员数，单位分／账户；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: purchase_frequency
metrics.label: 购买频次
metrics.description: 有效订单数除以购买会员数，单位单／账户；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: refund_amount_rate
metrics.label: 退款金额占比
metrics.description: 退款金额除以实付金额；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: cancel_rate
metrics.label: 取消率
metrics.description: 取消订单数除以创建订单数；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: refund_order_rate
metrics.label: 退款订单率
metrics.description: 退款订单数除以支付订单数；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: discount_rate
metrics.label: 优惠率
metrics.description: 优惠金额除以支付订单原价金额；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: items_per_order
metrics.label: 单均商品件数
metrics.description: 有效订单商品件数除以有效订单数；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: new_member_count
metrics.label: 注册会员数
metrics.description: 按注册日期统计新注册 CRM 账户数；可按归属门店和会员等级分组，不等于自然人数。

metrics.name: first_buyer_count
metrics.label: 观测期首购会员数
metrics.description: 在测试覆盖期内首次有效订单落入查询窗口的不同 CRM 账户数；不代表终身首购。先用全覆盖历史确定首次，再按窗口筛选。

metrics.name: first_order_sales_cents
metrics.label: 观测期首单净销售额
metrics.description: 每个账户在测试覆盖期内第一笔有效订单的净销售额，按该单日期归属；相同日期按订单号排序；单位分。

metrics.name: first_order_count
metrics.label: 观测期首单数
metrics.description: 在全测试覆盖期内先为每个账户按日期、订单号排序，其第一笔有效订单落入窗口的单数。

metrics.name: repeat_order_count
metrics.label: 观测期后续购买订单数
metrics.description: 账户全测试覆盖期内第二笔及以后的有效订单，按订单日期落入窗口计数。不是月内复购人数。

metrics.name: monthly_buyer_count
metrics.label: 月内购买会员数
metrics.description: 同一自然月有至少一笔有效订单的账户数，仅整月、全门店口径；允许连续整月按月分别展示，不能跨月直接加总当人数。

metrics.name: monthly_repeat_buyer_count
metrics.label: 月内复购会员数
metrics.description: 同一自然月有至少两笔有效订单的账户数，仅整月、全门店口径；不能由全量订单行上的简单条件代替。

metrics.name: monthly_repeat_rate
metrics.label: 月内复购率
metrics.description: 同一自然月的月内复购会员数除以月内购买会员数，仅整月、全门店口径；分母零时未定义；跨多月查询必须按月展示。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_buyer_count
metrics.label: 月末付费会员购买人数
metrics.description: 自然月内有至少一笔有效订单、且月末符合总部运营月报付费资格的不同账户数。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_order_count
metrics.label: 月末付费会员有效订单数
metrics.description: 月末符合付费资格的账户在该自然月的全部有效订单数，按账户资格筛选，不按卡重复。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_sales_cents
metrics.label: 月末付费会员净销售额
metrics.description: 月末符合付费资格的账户在该自然月的有效订单净销售额合计，单位分。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
metrics.label: 月末付费会员复购人数
metrics.description: 月末符合付费资格，且同一自然月至少有两笔有效订单的不同账户数。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_repeat_rate
metrics.label: 月末付费会员复购率
metrics.description: 月末付费会员复购人数除以月末付费会员购买人数；分母为零时未定义。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_avg_order_value
metrics.label: 月末付费会员订单均额
metrics.description: 月末付费会员净销售额除以月末付费会员有效订单数；单位分／单，分母零时未定义。

WITH valid_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY ordered_at, order_id) AS valid_seq
  FROM {{ ref('orders') }}
  WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.member_id,
    o.store_id,
    o.ordered_at,
    o.status,
    o.gross_cents,
    o.paid_cents,
    o.refund_cents,
    o.quantity,
    o.channel,
    m.home_store_id,
    COALESCE(r.valid_seq, 0) AS valid_seq
  FROM {{ ref('orders') }} o
  LEFT JOIN {{ ref('members') }} m
    ON o.member_id = m.member_id
  LEFT JOIN valid_ranked r
    ON o.order_id = r.order_id
)
SELECT * FROM base

model_sql.monthly_order_summary:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', date_day)::DATE AS month_start
  FROM {{ ref('time_spine') }}
),
member_month AS (
  SELECT
    member_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at)::DATE AS month_start,
    COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count
  FROM {{ ref('orders') }}
  WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0
  GROUP BY member_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at)::DATE
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT
    month_start,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE valid_order_count >= 1) AS buyer_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE valid_order_count >= 2) AS repeat_buyer_count
  FROM member_month
  GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT
  m.month_start,
  COALESCE(monthly.buyer_count, 0) AS buyer_count,
  COALESCE(monthly.repeat_buyer_count, 0) AS repeat_buyer_count
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN monthly
  ON m.month_start = monthly.month_start
model_sql.monthly_paid_summary:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', date_day)::DATE AS month_start
  FROM {{ ref('time_spine') }}
),
month_ends AS (
  SELECT
    month_start,
    (month_start + INTERVAL '1 month' - INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE AS month_end
  FROM months
),
cards_scoped AS (
  SELECT
    c.*,
    CASE
      WHEN c.valid_from IS NOT NULL
       AND c.valid_until IS NOT NULL
       AND c.valid_from < c.valid_until
       AND (c.ended_at IS NULL OR (c.ended_at > c.valid_from AND c.ended_at < c.valid_until))
      THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
    END AS p1_precheck_ok
  FROM {{ ref('cards') }} c
  WHERE c.card_type IN ('悦享年卡', '家庭季卡')
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT
    me.month_start,
    c.member_id
  FROM month_ends me
  JOIN cards_scoped c
    ON c.p1_precheck_ok
   AND c.valid_from <= me.month_end
   AND me.month_end < c.valid_until
   AND (c.ended_at IS NULL OR me.month_end < c.ended_at)
  GROUP BY me.month_start, c.member_id
),
pending AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT me.month_start
  FROM month_ends me
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM cards_scoped c
    WHERE c.p1_precheck_ok = FALSE
  )
),
valid_orders AS (
  SELECT
    member_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at)::DATE AS month_start,
    COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count,
    SUM(paid_cents - refund_cents) AS net_sales_cents
  FROM {{ ref('orders') }}
  WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0
  GROUP BY member_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at)::DATE
),
monthly_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    me.month_start,
    e.member_id,
    COALESCE(o.valid_order_count, 0) AS valid_order_count,
    COALESCE(o.net_sales_cents, 0) AS net_sales_cents
  FROM month_ends me
  LEFT JOIN eligible e
    ON e.month_start = me.month_start
  LEFT JOIN valid_orders o
    ON o.month_start = e.month_start
   AND o.member_id = e.member_id
),
summary AS (
  SELECT
    month_start,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE member_id IS NOT NULL AND valid_order_count >= 1) AS buyer_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN member_id IS NOT NULL THEN valid_order_count ELSE 0 END) AS order_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN member_id IS NOT NULL THEN net_sales_cents ELSE 0 END) AS sales_cents,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE member_id IS NOT NULL AND valid_order_count >= 2) AS repeat_buyer_count
  FROM monthly_accounts
  GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT
  s.month_start,
  CASE WHEN p.month_start IS NULL THEN s.buyer_count ELSE NULL END AS buyer_count,
  CASE WHEN p.month_start IS NULL THEN s.order_count ELSE NULL END AS order_count,
  CASE WHEN p.month_start IS NULL THEN s.sales_cents ELSE NULL END AS sales_cents,
  CASE WHEN p.month_start IS NULL THEN s.repeat_buyer_count ELSE NULL END AS repeat_buyer_count
FROM summary s
LEFT JOIN pending p
  ON s.month_start = p.month_start
